text: I am glad that you have decided to work purposefully with the seventh chakra for a month, that is, to direct attention to transcendent states that we perceive with awe, as contact with God. At first glance, I have listed natural states characteristic of many people. However, in society there are many both inciting and prohibitive scenarios that control our behavior, sometimes leading to life becoming materialistic, filled with existential fears, a sense of meaninglessness… By performing practices both on the yoga mat and in life, reflecting, correcting your thoughts and actions, over the course of a month you can obtain important results that will manifest both at the level of the body (healing) and at the level of psychological background (satisfaction and happiness).
